title: 升维的联合进入条件与单边热税惩罚
core_statement: A6 升维操作 Φ: L0 → L1 的有效性条件是 joint_enter(L0→L1)；当邀请被拒时，系统不处于 L1，且已付 fee_entry 构成不可约化热税损失 ΔQ > 0，并可能触发对邀请方的信誉降级（GRIM 类稳定子）。因此单向 TRUST_INVITE 不是升维，是热税净损。

formal_conditions.joint_enter: A sends INVITE ∧ B accepts ∧ both synchronously enter L1 norm field
formal_conditions.failed_invite: A pays fee_entry + B does not commit → ΔQ = fee_entry + penalty_failure, Δφ = -|η_after - η_before|
formal_conditions.may_invite: if B.open_to_trust ∧ ¬B.grim_triggered_by_invite: send INVITE else: stay L0, spend 0

empirical_evidence.design: 4 strategy pairs × 5 trust_budget groups × 5 seeds × 20 rounds = 2000 rounds

nash_breaker_cautious_v1.interpretation: unilateral invites → pure heat tax loss

nash_breaker_cautious_v2.interpretation: H634 gate reduces loss by 50%, Nash exemption protects receiver in (D,D) lock

adaptive_x2.interpretation: H634 optimizes noise tolerance for homogeneous pairs

implementation.gate_logic: Nash exemption (receiver in (D,D) → ignore) + 2-strike (non-Nash unilateral → count, 2nd → close)
implementation.budget_protection: may_invite check prevents budget waste when opp_open_to_trust=False

theoretical_implications: Elevation bottleneck shifts from A3 (budget) to A5 (opponent's norm field acceptance)
Joint_enter is the irreducible unit of A6 — partial enter = no enter
H634 completes the A3-A6 bridge: A3 governs cost, A6 governs possibility, H634 governs boundary
open_questions: Q1: Can open_to_trust be recovered after closure? (current design: permanent GRIM)
Q2: Is multi-agent (N>2) trust closure transitive?
Q3: Optimal strike threshold for different noise levels
